findings.claim: GE Aerospace 2026-07 稱引擎維修與備品需求撐住，供給限制而非客戶需求才是延至 2027 的較大挑戰
findings.source: CP24/Reuters: GE Aerospace sees repair demand holding up despite aviation fuel shock
